description: When a workspace has a title respondents can read (publish check workspace_title_missing). A title needs at least one visible character (Cf, Zs, Zl, Zp, Cc and the fillers U+115F U+1160 U+3164 U+FFA0, Braille blank U+2800, U+00AD, U+180E show nothing) and is not 'untitled' in any case. Run by backend/tests/app/services/test_workspace_title_check.py (services/publish_checks.py has_workspace_title) and webapp src/utils/publish-checks.test.ts (hasWorkspaceTitle), so the builder and the server agree.
